versions.name: RXV2-0.9.524-alpha-subtitle
versions.notes: A la carte subtitle says 'In alphabetical order' (the old 'roughly in setup order' was no longer true).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.523-alacarte-alpha
versions.notes: A la carte menu sorted alphabetically - random-access choices are easiest to find in ABC order.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.522-gear-dedup
versions.notes: Gear-ratio pages lose the paragraph that duplicated the label's help bubble.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.521-tidy-rows
versions.notes: First-time basics, Rescue and Servos pages decluttered: every row is just its underlined title - press for a fuller explanation (43 rows converted).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.520-hint-on-hub
versions.notes: The help-bubble explanation moves from the wizard to the Rotorflight front page - it applies to everything Rotorflight.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.519-clean-checklist
versions.notes: Wizard checklist decluttered: each step is just its underlined title - press and hold for a fuller explanation than the old subtext ever gave.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.518-bubble-hint
versions.notes: Wizard opens with a self-demonstrating note: underlined term? Put your finger on it for an explanation - and the note's own underline is a live example.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.517-bailout-findable
versions.notes: Governor page now says plainly: bail-out is enabled by Auto throttle above 0 - there is no separate switch (note beside the autorotation timeout + a fuller bubble).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.516-timeout-bubbles
versions.notes: Throttle-hold vs autorotation timeout bubbles now spell out the difference: ordinary throttle chop vs deliberate auto with bail-out.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.515-bubble-above
versions.notes: Help bubbles always appear ABOVE the finger (pinned to the top edge when the label is high on the screen) - never below.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.514-bubble-polish
versions.notes: Help bubbles: no more iOS drag-ghost on finger movement, bubbles sit well clear of the finger, and ~20 more added (tail travel, battery divider, gear ratio, switch cards, every Transmitter-channels row).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.513-help-bubbles
versions.notes: Press-and-hold help bubbles: touch any dotted-underlined label (governor, PIDs, rates, travel, servos - about 90 so far) and a plain-English explanation appears; lift your finger and it goes.
